∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (labels : List (Fin m)) (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
      (rows : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow) (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ)
      (τ : Fin n → ENNReal),
      Monotone τ →
        ∀ (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ answer →
            ∀ (j : Fin n),
              ↑((outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start rows answer (n * labels.length)).clock -
                    start) ≤
                ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.couponWork n labels x start rows answer j + (↑j + 1)) /
                    ∑ i ≤ j, (τ i)⁻¹ +
                  τ j

                (O :
                  OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                    (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                  outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.batchScheduleIndependent q f τ O →
                    ∀ (batch : ℕ),
                      have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                      (Measurable fun z => outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedLabels q O z.1 z.2 batch) ∧
                        (∀ᵐ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) ∂P,
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.isDifferenceBatch q O z batch →
                              ∀ (j : Fin q.S),
                                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedLabels q O z.1 z.2 batch j).isSome = true) ∧
                          ∀ (E : Set (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k))),
                            MeasurableSet E →
                              (∀ z ∈ E, outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.isDifferenceBatch q O z batch) →
                                ∀ (v : Fin q.S → Fin q.m),
                                  P
                                      (E ∩
                                        {z |
                                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedLabels q O z.1 z.2 batch = fun j =>
                                            some (v j)}) =
                                    P E * (↑q.m ^ q.S)⁻¹

∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (labels : List (Fin m)),
      0 < labels.length →
        ∀ (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
          (rows : Ω → ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow)
          (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ) (τ : Fin n → ENNReal)
          (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → Ω → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
          Measurable rows →
            (∀ (a : ℕ), Measurable fun z => answer a z.1 z.2) →
              (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂↑P, outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => answer a r ω) →
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.FullFresh P n labels x start rows answer →
                  ∀ (j : Fin n) (u : ℕ),
                    0 < u →
                      ∫⁻ (ω : Ω),
                          ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.couponWaiting n labels x start (rows ω)
                              (fun a r => answer a r ω) j u) ∂↑P ≤
                        1 + ↑(min (↑j + 1) labels.length) / ↑u

declarations.name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.difference_average
declarations.type_text:
∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
            (O :
              OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n))
            (seed : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K) (ω : (k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k),
            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => O.answer 1 a (0, r) (ω a)) →
              ∀ (batch firstID : ℕ) (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d) (clock : NNReal),
                outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.invocation q O seed ω batch = some (false, x, y, clock, firstID) →
                  outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.batchResult q O seed ω batch =
                    (↑q.S)⁻¹ •
                      ∑ j,
                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedLabels q O seed ω batch j).elim 0 fun i =>
                          gradient (f i) x - gradient (f i) y

declarations.name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.difference_event_bound
declarations.type_text:
∀ {d m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (n S : ℕ),
      0 < n →
        ∀ (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
          (rows : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow) (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ)
          (τ : Fin n → ENNReal)
          (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ answer →
            (∀ a ≤ S, (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.differenceTrace n S x y start rows answer a).count = a) ∧
              ∀ (a : ℕ),
                S ≤ a →
                  outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.differenceTrace n S x y start rows answer a =
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.differenceTrace n S x y start rows answer S

declarations.name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.difference_moments
declarations.type_text:
∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          0 < q.ρ →
            q.ρ ≤ 1 →
              ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ : ℝ),
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f q.x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ →
                  ∀ (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
                    (O :
                      OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.batchScheduleIndependent q f τ O →
                        ∀ (batch : ℕ),
                          have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                          have error := outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.batchError q f O batch;
                          MeasureTheory.Integrable error P ∧
                            MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun z => ‖error z‖ ^ 2) P ∧
                              ∀ (E : Set (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k))),
                                MeasurableSet E →
                                  (∀ z ∈ E, outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.isDifferenceBatch q O z batch) →
                                    ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)) in E,

      (τ : Fin n → ENNReal)
      (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
      outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ answer →
        (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start rows answer (n * labels.length)).remaining = [] ∧
          ∀ (a : ℕ),
            n * labels.length ≤ a →
              outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start rows answer a =
                outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start rows answer (n * labels.length)

          (rows : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow) (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ),
          (∀ (i : Fin m), Differentiable ℝ (f i)) →
            ∀ (τ : Fin n → ENNReal)
              (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
              outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ answer →
                outputs.Algorithms.FreyaCollectors.fullResult
                    (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n (List.ofFn id) x start rows answer (n * m)) =
                  gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f) x

∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) {d m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      0 < n →
        ∀ (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
          (rows : Ω → ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow)
          (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ) (τ : Fin n → ENNReal),
          Monotone τ →
            ∀ (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → Ω → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
              Measurable rows →
                (∀ (a : ℕ), Measurable fun z => answer a z.1 z.2) →
                  (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂↑P, outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => answer a r ω) →
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.FullFresh P n (List.ofFn id) x start rows answer →
                      (Measurable fun ω =>
                          (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n (List.ofFn id) x start (rows ω)
                              (fun a r => answer a r ω) (n * m)).clock) ∧
                        ∫⁻ (ω : Ω),
                            ↑((outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n (List.ofFn id) x start (rows ω)
                                    (fun a r => answer a r ω) (n * m)).clock -
                                start) ∂↑P ≤
                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.multisetTimeBound τ m

∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) {d m : ℕ},
  0 < m →
    ∀ (n : ℕ),
      0 < n →
        outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.largeSample m n →
          ∀ (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
            (rows : Ω → ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow)
            (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ) (τ : Fin n → ENNReal),
            Monotone τ →
              ∀
                (answer :
                  ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → Ω → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
                Measurable rows →
                  (∀ (a : ℕ), Measurable fun z => answer a z.1 z.2) →
                    (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂↑P, outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => answer a r ω) →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.FullFresh P n (List.ofFn id) x start rows answer →
                        ∫⁻ (ω : Ω),
                            ↑((outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n (List.ofFn id) x start (rows ω)
                                    (fun a r => answer a r ω) (n * m)).clock -
                                start) ∂↑P ≤
                          5 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑m

declarations.type_text:
∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (labels : List (Fin m)) (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
      (rows : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow) (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ)
      (τ : Fin n → ENNReal)
      (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
      outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ answer →
        ∀ (a : ℕ),
          have s := outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start rows answer a;
          s.remaining.Nodup ∧
            (∀ b ∈ s.remaining, b < labels.length) ∧
              start ≤ s.clock ∧
                s.sum + (List.map (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.contribution f labels x) s.remaining).sum =
                    (List.map (fun i => gradient (f i) x) labels).sum ∧
                  (s.remaining ≠ [] →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.legalRequest τ { clock := s.clock, pending := s.pending }) ∧
                    (∀ (i : Fin n) (job : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Job d m),
                        s.pending i = some job → job.kind = Sum.inl x ∧ job.id < s.nextID) ∧
                      ∀ (i i' : Fin n) (job job' : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Job d m),
                        s.pending i = some job → s.pending i' = some job' → job.id = job'.id → i = i'

∀ {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (labels : List (Fin m)) (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
      (rows : ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow) (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ)
      (τ : Fin n → ENNReal)
      (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
      outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ answer →
        outputs.Algorithms.FreyaCollectors.fullResult
            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start rows answer (n * labels.length)) =
          (↑labels.length)⁻¹ • (List.map (fun i => gradient (f i) x) labels).sum

∀ {Ω : Type} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] (P : MeasureTheory.ProbabilityMeasure Ω) {d m : ℕ} (n : ℕ),
  0 < n →
    ∀ (labels : List (Fin m)),
      0 < labels.length →
        ∀ (x : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d) (start : NNReal)
          (rows : Ω → ℕ → outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.ChoiceRow)
          (f : Fin m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space d → ℝ) (τ : Fin n → ENNReal),
          Monotone τ →
            ∀ (answer : ℕ → Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request d m n) → Ω → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply d n),
              Measurable rows →
                (∀ (a : ℕ), Measurable fun z => answer a z.1 z.2) →
                  (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂↑P, outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => answer a r ω) →
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.FullFresh P n labels x start rows answer →
                      (Measurable fun ω =>
                          (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start (rows ω) (fun a r => answer a r ω)
                              (n * labels.length)).clock) ∧
                        ∫⁻ (ω : Ω),
                            ↑((outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.fullTrace n labels x start (rows ω)
                                    (fun a r => answer a r ω) (n * labels.length)).clock -
                                start) ∂↑P ≤
                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.multisetTimeBound τ labels.length

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
            (O :
              OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n))
            (seed : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K) (ω : (k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k),
            (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.servicePath f τ fun a r => O.answer 1 a (0, r) (ω a)) →
              ∀ (batch firstID : ℕ) (x y : outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d) (clock : NNReal),
                outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.invocation q O seed ω batch = some (false, x, y, clock, firstID) →
                  ∀ (γ : outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.BatchSchedule q.n),
                    outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.ScheduleRealization q f τ O seed ω batch γ →
                      have callStart := (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.batchStartCall q O seed ω batch).getD 0;
                      (Function.Injective fun j =>
                          outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.selectedJobID γ firstID callStart clock ↑j) ∧
                        (∀ (j : Fin q.S),
                            Option.map (fun job => job.id)
                                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedJob q O seed ω batch j) =
                              some (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.selectedJobID γ firstID callStart clock ↑j)) ∧
                          ∀ (j : Fin q.S),
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.completedLabels q O seed ω batch j =
                              outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.batchLabels q seed batch
                                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.selectedJobID γ firstID callStart clock ↑j)
